name: channel-google-chat
title: Google Chat: chat with your agent in Google Chat spaces, group chats and DMs
description: A Google Chat app of your own (a Workspace add-on) answers in each message's thread: Thinking… written as the model writes, tables and code as cards, photos and files read, questions asked with buttons and forms. On a server or on Cloudflare.

environment.name: GOOGLE_CHAT_SERVICE_ACCOUNT
environment.description: The Chat app's service account JSON key, whole (Google Cloud console, IAM, Service accounts, Keys). The app calls the Chat API as it. A named app reads GOOGLE_CHAT_<NAME>_SERVICE_ACCOUNT.

environment.name: GOOGLE_CHAT_PROJECT_NUMBER
environment.description: The number of the Chat app's Google Cloud project: Google signs every event as service-<number>@gcp-sa-gsuiteaddons.iam.gserviceaccount.com.

environment.name: GOOGLE_CHAT_AUDIENCE
environment.description: The endpoint URL exactly as the Chat API's configuration has it (https://<your host>/google-chat): every event's token is for it.

environment.name: GOOGLE_CHAT_ALLOWED_SPACES
environment.description: The spaces the app answers (spaces/AAA, or their ids), separated by commas. Any other space is told it is not allowed, with its id to add here. Empty: none yet.
